context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed Expenses (Gastos Fijos) module fully tested. Backend API endpoints at /api/fixed-expenses work correctly with proper role-based access control. SuperAdmin can create/edit/delete fixed expenses and trigger manual generation. Admin can create/edit/delete but cannot trigger generation. User has no access. Frontend page at /configuracion/gastos-fijos shows differentiated views based on role. APScheduler configured to auto-generate expenses daily at 00:05. Test file created at /app/backend/tests/test_fixed_expenses.py for regression testing. Existing fixed expenses in system: Planilla Abril (Q12,000, Day 12) and Alquiler Local (Q5,000, Day 15) for Laboratorios Visión S.A.
